summary: Iteration 84 - All 2 UI fixes verified successfully. Fix 1: SearchableItemSelect dropdown portal renders to document.body with position:fixed, z-index:9999 - NOT clipped by parent overflow. Fix 2: Drag-and-drop rows have draggable=true, drag handles, and auto-scroll code in useDraggableRows.js. All regression tests from iteration_83 pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All fixes from iteration 84 verified: (1) SearchableItemSelect dropdown uses createPortal to document.body with position:fixed - tested in PO, Quotation, and Tax Invoice dialogs, (2) Drag-and-drop rows have draggable=true attribute and drag handles, auto-scroll code verified in useDraggableRows.js with SCROLL_EDGE=80px and SCROLL_MAX_SPEED=18. fix_1_dropdown_portal.details: SearchableItemSelect dropdown panel rendered via createPortal to document.body. Verified in PO (po-line-item-0-panel), Quotation (quotation-line-item-0-panel), and Tax Invoice (ti-line-item-0-panel) dialogs. Panel uses position:fixed, z-index:9999, and is NOT clipped by parent overflow-x-auto.

fix_2_drag_drop_reorder.details: All line item rows have draggable=true attribute and .drag-handle class on row-num cell. useDraggableRows hook properly attached to PO, Quotation, and Tax Invoice grids.

fix_3_auto_scroll.details: Auto-scroll code in useDraggableRows.js verified: findScrollableAncestor(), updateAutoScroll(), requestAnimationFrame loop. SCROLL_EDGE=80px, SCROLL_MAX_SPEED=18. Dialog with 12 rows is scrollable (scrollHeight:2024 > clientHeight:992). Full interaction test requires real mouse drag.

fix_4_description_search.details: SearchableItemSelect searches by description. Typing 'cold' matches 'Cold rolled steel sheet' description and shows RM-001 Steel Sheet 4mm. Description shown as 2nd line under part_number/name.

regression_footer_buttons.details: Footer Add Line buttons visible: po-add-line-footer-btn, quotation-add-line-footer, ti-add-line-footer all present in tfoot.

regression_customers_permissions.details: Add Customer button (add-customer-btn) visible for admin. Customer scope filter (customer-scope-filter) visible for admin.
